task: Skeptic (value + feasibility) of R3S-8 (recheck: the finals pair K2/twin still hedges correctly; D4 stays trigger-only)
reason: The substance holds on every point I checked. (1) The twin's work is a strict subset of K2's. Same GPU phase, same lowrefine, same REPAIR_DEADLINE_S 34200. It has no divinsert and no ft-weights dataset. Dummy repair time is 219 s vs 509 s, and the gap is the DaughterNet scoring (298 s over 4 clips, ~72 s/clip, so ~2 h over a hidden N of ~100). The twin therefore cannot hit a deadline K2 avoids; the only caveat is separate machine draws, with ~3.7 h of headroom. (2) safetail is inert while no deadline fires (K1 sha == exp57b) and fail-soft (the FD/FF dummies pass). (3) lowrefine is guarded: the bounded head (<= 2 um), np.clip, and a raise on non-finite values or > 2.00001 um, caught per frame as 'LOWREFINE FAILED ... grid coordinates kept' (build_probe_kernel.py l.1107, l.1632). (4) The deadline clock is KERNEL_START_TS (l.1398), so runtime <= L, and L(K2) <= 8.0 h does prove that the DIVINS deadline never fired. (5) D4 is trigger-only per FINAL_REPORT_v4 item 5. The objective is P(private > raw x138), so the x138 base being common to both files is out of scope, and lowrefine is correctly named as the only unhedged shared component. Weaknesses, none fatal. (a) 'Insertion ran on every hidden clip (proven)' overclaims: L <= 8.0 h rules out the deadline skip, not a per-clip 'DIVINS FAILED' fail-soft, which is invisible on the hidden rerun. (b) 'No runtime cost' for lowrefine is really 'below machine noise'. Dummy start of the first repair is K2 ~1000 s vs K1 ~1179 s and twin ~818 s vs exp56 ~884 s: both lowrefine builds are faster, and the noise is ~+-180 s per 4 clips. (c) The action is redundant: the A5 ledger already has the insertion-gate column and the WATCH A5-L(K2) trigger. Value is info-only, and the finding changes no decision.
fix: Keep it as info, with two edits. (1) Reword the note to: 'L(K2) <= 8.0 h => the insertion deadline never fired on the hidden rerun; a per-clip DIVINS FAILED is unobservable'. Do not write 'insertion ran on every hidden clip (proven)'. (2) Record L(twin) next to L(K2) when both score. Both were submitted at ~00:01, so L(K2) - L(twin) is a free upper-bound read of the hidden insertion cost; the dummy predicts ~72 s/clip, i.e. ~2 h at N ~100. That calibrates the D4 / deadline-shift trigger (L(K2) > 8.0 h or F > 7.9 h) without a slot. No build, no slot, no rule change; R3S-1/R3S-7 carry the lowrefine question.
realistic_gain: ~0 score (info-only; the hedge was already correct). The L(K2) - L(twin) read adds a small amount of runtime-risk calibration for the D4 trigger, worth <1e-5 in expectation.
